title: Select tests by the repo files they read in tests/affected.py
lead: `tests/affected.py` maps each test to the Python lines it executed under `src/slicer/` and `tests/`. A diff that touches only Markdown or another non-Python file selects nothing, so `affected.py --run` prints "nothing to run" and exits 0. Tests do read those files: `test_docs_coverage` reads `README.md` and `docs/commands.md`, and other tests read `CHANGELOG.md` and packaged templates. This slice records the repo files each test opens and selects tests by them, then updates AGENTS.md so a docs-only change has a check that matches the practice.
findings_note: owner and orchestrator, 2026-10-14: affected.py --run prints nothing to run for a docs-only diff although tests read README and docs; AGENTS.md has no docs-only rule
boundary: Not in this slice: CI use of the map, tracing files outside the repo, changing the line-tracing rules, and making the full discover optional for any diff under src/ or tests/.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The owner asked on 2026-10-14 whether a docs-only slice needs the full suite. AGENTS.md says to run `affected.py --run` while iterating, and for a docs diff that answer is falsely empty. With file reads mapped, `affected.py` selects exactly the tests that read a changed doc. AGENTS.md can then let a diff with nothing under `src/` or `tests/` finish on `affected.py --run`, `slicer check` and `git diff --check` instead of a five-minute discover.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/affected.py`: record per-test file reads, store them in the map, select by them.
- `tests/test_affected.py`: the tests below.
- `AGENTS.md`: the docs-only rule in the Commands section and the claim block.
- `docs/landing.md` if it repeats the suite rule.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_TraceSuite_TestReadsRepoFile_RecordsTheRead`: a fixture test that opens a Markdown file under the fixture root records that file's relative path for that test; a file outside the root, under `.git/` or under `.venv/` is not recorded.
- `test_Select_ChangedMarkdownReadByATest_SelectsThatTest`: a map whose test read `README.md` and a diff touching only `README.md` select that test.
- `test_Select_ChangedFileNoTestRead_SaysNothingToRun`: a changed non-Python file no test read still prints "nothing to run" and exits 0.
- `test_Select_MapWithoutReads_RunsFullSuite`: a map written before this change, with no reads key, is treated as stale and asks for the full suite with a reason.
- `test_Select_ChangedTemplateUnderSrc_SelectsReaders`: a non-Python file under `src/slicer/` that a test read selects its readers instead of asking for the full suite; one no test read still asks for the full suite.
- The existing map round-trip test covers the new key, with sorted output.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. In `_TracingResult`, record reads through one `sys.addaudithook` listener for the `open` event. An audit hook cannot be removed, so install it once per process and have it record only while a test is current. Keep paths that resolve under the root, skipping `.git/` and `.venv/`, as POSIX paths relative to the root. Cache resolution per path, as `_project_file` does for code.
3. Write the reads into the map beside `tests` with a fixed key order and sorted lists. `load_map` refuses a map without them, so the caller is told to run the full suite.
4. In `_emit`, a changed path a test read selects that test. A non-Python path under `src/slicer/` that some test read no longer forces the full suite.
5. Measure a full discover with the hook against one without and put both times in the report. If the hook adds more than 10%, stop and ask the owner.
6. Update AGENTS.md: when a diff touches nothing under `src/` or `tests/`, `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, `slicer check` and `git diff --check` replace the full discover before done. Any change under `src/` or `tests/` still needs one full discover.
7. Mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The full suite passes on Python 3.11+, and the map it writes has reads for `test_docs_coverage` tests that include `README.md` and `docs/commands.md`.
- With that map, a one-line edit to `README.md` makes `affected.py` list the docs coverage tests, and an edit to a doc no test reads prints "nothing to run".
- `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s270`, branch `feature/s270-affected-reads`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
